brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Provide tidy storage for sewing supplies (compartmentalised organizer)
requirements.evidence: Build has 3 hex cells with bins: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) + bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments) + bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-cup (mug/centre). Gives 6 organized compartments for small supplies. Props demonstrate use: prop:1 tweezers, prop:2 marker, prop:3 mug in cup holder. Check_build ok, meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Show sewing-specific items (thread spools, scissors, needles, fabric) staged
requirements.evidence: No sewing props exist in catalog – searches for 'sewing', 'scissors', 'thread', 'spool' returned 0 or only filament-spool. Closest proxies placed were tweezers/marker as small tools and mug. Tape/tape-gaffer/ruler/brush refused with PROP_NO_REST (overlaps bin wall). Cannot demonstrate true sewing kit without inventing props.

finish.summary: 3-cell cluster provides 5+1 compartment storage for small sewing notions, capped and bolted (check_build ok, mesh clear). Sewing-specific staging is limited – catalog has no scissors/thread, so generic tools used and larger props refused placement.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
